intent: Implement InMemoryHistoryEventPublisher (Java 21, Spring Boot 3, WebFlux/Reactor/R2DBC, constructor injection, no blocking calls) so that the frozen test passes, providing exactly the ast_hints table and nothing improvised. Unit contract: Infrastructure adapter implementing HistoryEventPublisher with Sinks.many().replay().limit(properties.broadcastCapacity()) (bounded, drops oldest, never overflows or terminates). publish uses emitNext with Sinks.EmitFailureHandler.busyLooping(properties.emitRetryTimeout()). Owns the step log 'event broadcast downstream' (one logger call per published event). Registered ONLY by the wiring unit TelemetryConfiguration.
